Fifteen record types gated: bundle, claim, scope, proposition/program, refusal contract, refusal, refusal_witness, evidence, case, side, equality, execution_provenance, operand, child, aggregate. Codes proof-/domain-/compose-vocabulary-unknown. REPRODUCED BEFORE REPAIR: 8 of 8 forged artifacts accepted by the shipped P3 pack, including a certificate printing THE RIEMANN HYPOTHESIS IS PROVED FOR ALL NON-TRIVIAL ZEROES under DOMAIN-CHECK: PASS, and P1 printing P = NP under PROOF-CHECK: PASS after one further reseal. 12 aggregate fields were hashed and compared to nothing -- including P1's `failed`, the headline count of failed cases -- and all 12 are derived now. Forgeries proof 24/24, domain 28/28, compose 20/20; negative battery 377/377 including grammar-accepts-unknown-keys and public-result-incoherent, both verified to parse, load and flip exactly their named property. grid_check probes grammar() and publicResult() directly and feeds checkBundle a bundle that FAILS WHILE ASSERTING VERIFIED, which discriminates a checker that reads its verdict from one that computes it.
attrs.statement: AUTHENTICATION IS NOT VERIFICATION. A field being inside a hash is meaningless unless the verifier DERIVES it, CHECKS it, or explicitly classifies it as NON-SEMANTIC. For every machine-semantic record accepted under a proof protocol the checker owns the EXACT set and interpretation of accepted fields; an unknown semantic field is a REFUSAL, and extending the vocabulary is a protocol revision rather than an addition to a record. THIS IS emission.profile-is-interpreted@1's RULE ONE LAYER OUT: that law says a hashed field is a value the code READS, and read it as a rule about PROSE -- it is a rule about VOCABULARY, because a producer who can ADD a field can state things the checker never agreed to without altering any value the checker looks at. P1, P2 and P3 each shipped accepting a resealed scope.proves_all_naturals / proves_all_integers / transitive, and P3's claim and operand records had no vocabulary at all, so the field did not even have to be resealed. NON-AUTHORITATIVE PROSE LIVES IN A SEPARATE TRUST DOMAIN, never nested inside an authenticated record: an unhashed seat inside a semantic object is where evidence hides, and bounding such a seat guards a hole rather than filling it. A CHECKER MAY NOT LET A PRODUCER NAME WHAT A PASS PROVED -- canonical descriptions are RENDERED by the checker from the artifact it actually checked. AND THE PUBLIC RESULT IS COHERENT: ok is true exactly when the verdict is VERIFIED, so a parent asking `verdict` and a parent asking `ok` cannot disagree about the same child.
